prompt: A team needs to insert and update PI point values from SQL. Which product supports this?
explanation: PI OLEDB Provider offers read/write (CRUD) access to PI point data. PI OLEDB Enterprise is read-only and covers AF, not points. The RTQP engine exposes one AF database.

prompt: A report queries piarchive..piinterp and shows values at odd times such as 10:09:51. The user wanted the archived events. Which table should they use?
explanation: piinterp returns interpolated values at a timestep (default 1 h) aligned to the query time, which caused the odd timestamps. picomp2 returns archived events with their real timestamps.

prompt: What is the only built-in catalog in the RTQP engine?
explanation: The only built-in RTQP catalog is Master, with tables such as Master.Element.Element, Master.Element.Attribute and Master.EventFrame.EventFrame. piarchive and pipoint are PI OLEDB Provider catalogs.

prompt: Match each PI OLEDB Provider catalog to what it contains.

pairs.right: Point configuration tables, one per point class

explanation: From the PI OLEDB basics: piarchive holds archive-related tables, pipoint holds point configuration (one table per point class), pids holds digital state tables and piuser holds user database tables.

prompt: When migrating PI OLEDB Enterprise queries to RTQP, which rules apply? Choose all that apply.

options.text: Use PrimaryPath and Template columns instead of joining ElementHierarchy and ElementTemplate
Subqueries are supported only in FROM
Use positional ? parameters instead of named parameters
OPTION (FORCE ORDER) is required for joins
Event frame versions are now queried with a Version column

explanation: The 2020 migration lab lists: use PrimaryPath and Template columns directly instead of joining hierarchy and template tables; subqueries only in FROM; OPTION (FORCE ORDER) not supported; named parameters not supported (use positional ?). Event frame versioning was dropped, not added.

prompt: What Java class name does a JDBC client load for the PI JDBC Driver?
explanation: The PI JDBC driver class is com.osisoft.jdbc.Driver, in PIJDBCDriver.jar under PIPC\JDBC.

prompt: Ignition chart fails on picomp2 values.
scenario:
An Ignition project connects through PI JDBC and runs `SELECT TOP 10 tag, time, value FROM piarchive..picomp2 WHERE tag = 'sinusoid'`. The query returns rows, but the chart component will not plot them.

What is the documented fix?

options.text: Select cast(value as Float32) instead of value
Switch the driver to PI OLEDB Enterprise

explanation: picomp2 stores values as variants instead of separate float and string columns, and some clients such as Ignition charts fail unless the value is cast: cast(value as Float32). Switching to piinterp would return interpolated values instead of archived events.

prompt: piarchive..piavg returns which kind of average by default, and how do you get the other kind?

options.text: Time-weighted; use pimean or calcbasis = 'EventWeighted' for event-weighted
Time-weighted only; event-weighted is not available

explanation: piavg is time-weighted by default. For event-weighted results, query pimean or add calcbasis = 'EventWeighted'.

prompt: What changed in PI SQL Client 2018 R2 compared with the first 2018 release?

options.text: It added ODBC and JDBC drivers and removed the AF SDK dependency
It added write access to AF attributes
It removed the OLE DB driver
It added Data Archive tables to RTQP

explanation: The first release (2018) contained only OLE DB. 2018 R2 added ODBC and a pure-Java JDBC driver and removed the AF SDK dependency.

prompt: True or false: the PI JDBC driver can connect over net.tcp as well as HTTPS.
explanation: False. PI JDBC works over HTTPS only and requires PI SQL Data Access Server. PI ODBC and PI SQL Client in general can use net.tcp or HTTPS.

prompt: A query on pipoint..classic misses some tags. Which table does an OSIsoft staff answer recommend for all tags?
explanation: pipoint..classic returns only classic point-class attributes. pipoint2 is recommended unless an application needs backward compatibility.

prompt: How are RTQP template table-valued functions such as [Master].[Element].[GetSummary] invoked in a query?

options.text: With EXEC as a stored procedure

explanation: Template-based TVFs take the element template name and attribute names and are invoked with CROSS APPLY, as in the PI World 2020 wind-farm lab.

scenario:
A DBA set up a SQL Server Linked Server to PI OLEDB Provider. A four-part-name query with `time BETWEEN '*-1h' AND '*'` fails with "Conversion failed when converting date and/or time from character string".

What worked around this on PI Square?

options.text: Replace '*' with GETDATE() in the four-part query

explanation: Through a SQL Server Linked Server, PI time strings raised "Conversion failed when converting date and/or time from character string". Running the query with OPENQUERY passed it through to the PI provider and worked around the problem.

prompt: Which PI OLEDB function is the successor of the deprecated PICalcVal?
explanation: A PI Square answer states "PICalcVal function is deprecated and PIAdvCalcVal is its successor."
